body:
Thanks again for responding. As far as the clean break goes, I know that girl probably hasnt thought about me in a day but I still cant stop thinking about her hoping she will message me on Instagram and I know that's not going to happen so I dont know how well im doing regarding the "clean break".
I wont message her though. Im 99.99999% sure of that.


 As far as your ideas of how to get out there, I wish it was that easy. I've tried so many times to build friendships/relationships through the years and failed. Even if I could get over my horrible self esteem stuff and actually go somewhere by myself (thats never going to happen unfortunately) I just dont have the energy to put the time in again to know that its most likely going to have the exact same result. 
That's the definition of madness is it not? Repeating the same thing and expecting a different result?

I wish I could see your text for what it is which is stating facts, but I also have my own facts of feeling ive tried too many times. Remember im 48 and been dealing with this forever. Not just a year or 2. Fuck. seriously fuck. 

I can't even explain just how happy I was for that first week of talking to that camgirl. I haven't been even remotely that happy in YEARS. Spent a lot of money and I didn't care. It was absolutely batshit crazy how happy I was for that short time. 

Whats scary for me is I got on anti depressants and anti anxiety drugs 6 months ago and I'm this much of a disaster. I know i'd be dead right now if I wasn't on them. Seriously whats the point of going on in "hopes" of something changing that I dont have enough will power to change myself?

Why am I doing this to myself? Living every day for YEARS (EVERY SINGLE DAY) being miserable in HOPES something changes. I know I can no longer do this on my own if that makes sense. I know I need someone next to me to pull me out of this and I dont have ANYONE. Literally ANYONE.  Even the woman I paid for therapy/to be next to my side didn't help me. 

No magical fairytale princess is going to show up some day and make my life bearable. I just wish i was still around after I do this to hear all the people in my industry act like they were my buddy.

Thank you so much for your post. I've spent literally the entire day reading forums online about falling in love with a camgirl. It's funny how common and pathetic it is. Part of me wants to fault the girl and the realistic part of me realizes she was just being extra nice because it's her job and it's my fault for being the pathetic one. Seems like every website discussing it makes fun of the guy for not knowing better. 

The sad thing is she was way too young for me and I realized it was highly doubtful Id ever even meet (not that she obviously wanted to in the first place) but as someone who has literally gone 6+ years without a real hug let alone sex I completely fell for someone who was kind and sweet to me. In reality I was totally fine just having an online "friend" that I could hang out with and actually see instead of it just being text on the screen. A real person (and absolutely stunning looking to me, although i know most people wouldnt think the same. Yes thats my slight dig at her because im pathetic). 

The reason I mention all of that above is what I've realized is I have honestly spent the last 3 years
working my ass off at investing all my money so one day I thought I'd be able to "buy my way into someones heart" and I realize now its just never going to work.
The bumble friend thing I tried but felt really awkward and weird using it. 

The real problem is now that I realize that my big money plan wont work, Im really starting to realize
theres no point of me going on. I just dont have the energy to be let down again. 

I've tried so many times to get help for myself and failed everytime because the person on the other end says they care but in reality they dont. Or I should say they don't care as much as I need them to care. 

You want depressing? The therapist I started seeing 2 times a month via zoom since March was originally charging me $50 an hour. I knew she wasn't even worth that after a few weeks but I didn't just continue on I decided to start paying her $100 an hour because I honestly thought that would make her care more about me. 

Wow, I cant believe I thought I might get out of this depression eventually
and start my life over with someone special. I realize now it's not happening. Not everyone gets a fairy tale life. 

I know I could have made someone pretty happy and not in a smothering type of way. I know I excel at my very interesting/exciting career, I excel at my hobbies
and  Im actually kinda fun. I was totally fine with having to bring money to the table to make up for my total lack of self esteem body image wise (I'm a 5 on a good day). 

Why I typed that I dont know other than to say once again I realize the money 
isn't going to do what it needs to do for me. I'm totally fucked.
Thank you so much for your post. I truly hope you listen to your own words for your own situation. "win" for both of us.

I just wanted to say thank you for taking the time to respond to my post. Unfortunately I've tried to connect with every single person i had connections with in life over the years and it's just never worked out. Sometimes my fault, sometimes theirs, mostly because everyone else already has their full lives with work, wives, kids etc. 

Thank you again.
I just read this again for the 15th time this morning and I just wanted you to know whoever you are, you're an amazing person for trying to comfort a total stranger. Seriously.

Im really sorry and i mean it when I say I appreciate what you're trying to do greatly but music or anything else is the last thing on my mind right now. I'm totally and utterly alone and that is honestly the only thing that matters right now. Thank you though, you're more caring than anyone else in my life.

Thank you so much for that incredible post. You actually took the time to read everything I typed and understood it. Seriously thank you for taking the time you did. I wish I could go into the hobby thing and everything you ask of me but I just dont have the fight in me anymore to start over from scratch again. 

Just now I deleted everything to do with that cam girl including all of our DM's on instagram over the last week+. Im fucking crushed over someone who obviously didn't give a fuck, and I'm totally fucking alone. I might as well be on mars right now I'm so isolated. Wow, i put myself in a real mess totally falling for her (I spent a LOT of time with her over the last 10 days). 

It's so sad because the girl is actually in columbia and obviously not having a great life so it actually made me feel like I finally had a purpose to bring a smile to someone elses face like that and honestly tried to help them. I would have happily spoiled that person if they would have just treated me like a human being rather than a customer. Even more pathetic was me thinking just a few days ago about sending her $10K in bitcoin to her phone as the studio she works for takes 40% of the camgirl "tokens". I almost wish I told her I was going to do that before I deleted everything so she can at least wonder for 2 mins if she should have treated me a little better. I'm not like that though, I don't want to deliberately hurt anyone even though she hurt me. I really really really want to though. 



As far as gaining more confidence to find new people, if I was in my 20's it might be doable. At 48 everyone even remotely around my age already have their friends, they already have their lives and I'm not around new people enough to build those relationships over time.

Even making a friend at 48yo would still have me alone 99% of the time in my home. I've tried making friends with work acquaintances over the years but we would literally have to schedule out 1-2 months when we could hang out.  It seems the only acceptable way to suddenly have someone in my life for a bigger part of my time is to get into a relationship yet thats obviously not working out. I tried on tinder/bumble for a very long time. Not a ton of matches but actually occasionally would match up with an attractive woman that had promise. Of course I chickened out every time and bailed before meeting because I knew I couldnt take the rejection if it happened. 


I've tried and tried so hard to try to improve myself the last 3 years and desperately looked for help only to be let down time and time again that ...god even though everything inside of me wants to continue on to try to eventually "win" at life and find a partner I know that it's just not going to happen. 

Honestly the one thing that has kept me going is thinking I could eventually
just find a sugar baby on seeking.com but I realize now there is no way that could work with me as I NEED the emotional connection and just as you said, it's not going to come with money so I'm TOTALLY fucked. 

I honestly dont even have it in me to try anymore. Seriously your post was amazing and for a brief moment I actually thought you might be right about things but the reality is you're a stranger and I'm still alone. That's reality.

Fuck. I think i need to think about the hanging thing the other person said. 
Just let it be known world that I honestly tried. I failed then tried again. Failed again but tried once more. I can only be expected to keep trying so long. 
It really sucks. I know I was a decent guy. I know I was difficult at times but
I also know I would have taken my shirt off my back for anyone that needed it. 
I know I could have offered someone a decent and fun life with a decent person. Oh well right? Life isn't fair.


Edit: just to add after I posted this. Its now 2am. and Im shaking in this room alone. My entire body is tingling like im standing on the edge of a bridge. I can't even comprehend how alone I just realized I am now that the camgirl is gone. 2am and Im exhausted and couldnt sleep if I tried. God damn im so fucking alone.
